ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) boundaries and focal interior mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity clusters (mottling) localized in the medial region of the left lobe. Isolated dark circular spots on the right lobe. Solid low-intensity banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped vertex; depth is approximately 5% of total fluke span; angle estimated at 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; left lobe exhibits medium-amplitude irregular peaks; right lobe exhibits lower-amplitude, higher-frequency serrations with a single prominent deep vertical indentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast dark circular spots on the medial-left lobe; extensive high-density dark clusters on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular protrusions and dark pixel clusters on both distal lobe tips, characteristic of heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, distinct deep notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the median notch and the tip.
